channel.title: Comments for page "Secure Facility Dossier: Site-43"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Secure Facility Dossier: Site-43"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Thanks! I felt the Site needed a dossier at this point to flesh it out; I've got enough skips and characters to make it work, and I'll be doing a lot more with 43 soon. But I also felt that by 2020 a dossier needs to tell some stories rather than just containing the usual info, because we've got a lot of the old type already. Kind of a Series I vs Series VI sort of thing. I'm glad nobody's looked at my departments list and gone "too casual, downvoted" or "humour, downvoted" so far :P

The Memetics one occurred to me early, and I'm glad you feel the same way about it I do.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I really enjoy the department/sections portion of this page, usually site dossiers are cool, but a little boring to me, but that section bought a bit of a peek into the site itself. I really like this kind of interpretation of a foundation that seems more casual and isn't afraid to use anomalies. The Memetics section was especially fun. +1

item.title: Welcome to Hoserville
item.content:encoded:
Been sitting on this for a long time, and it's now an almost entirely different beast. It's 2020, so I'm not gonna post a Site Dossier that's just the usual format and expect it to fly… so, enjoy some ridiculous job humour, hopefully, and check out those linked academic papers! If they turn out not to suck, I'll write more of them eventually. (Already got one nearly finished to dust off the Site history.)

So, it's a Site dossier that's also a Foundation academic papers hub. Thanks to Grigori Karpin for convincing me that nobody would read a 5.5k dossier, thus prompting the creation of a whole new tale format / potentially disastrous mistake! If it turns out to be the latter, that's obviously my fault.
